newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares up on renewed Reliance bonus rumours.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares up on renewed Reliance bonus rumours.

text.p: Selective buying by foreign investors, mainly in shares of Reliance Industries on persistent rumours of a bonus issue, pushed Delhi shares higher in afternoon trade on Tuesday, brokers said.
At 12.45 p.m. (0715 GMT), the Delhi sensitive index was up 5.04 points at 852.72. Reliance Industries quoted 5.15 rupees higher at 322.80.
"The trend-setter Reliance Industries led the recovery in stocks, mainly on rumours of a bonus issue," said Bharat Bhushan of brokers Nu-Era Securities.
State Bank of India gained 3.50 rupees to 319.
ITC fell 3.50 rupees to 475.50 on foreign institutional selling.
